secondary_content.text: With a reputation for supplying quality European solutions for patios and awnings, our extensive range has been put together with the needs of our clients in mind. We can cater to your specific requirements, delivering custom designs that best suit your property. Whether you need external awning blinds and custom patio sun shades or balcony shades, we have you covered.
We can supply, custom-design and install the following:
✓ All weather awnings & retractable outdoor awnings

As leading retractable awnings suppliers, we’re proud to offer you ways to enjoy your outdoor living areas and patios all year round without having to worry about the unpredictable weather Melbourne is known for. Our range of external awnings will imbue your windows, glass roofs, pergolas, balconies, skylights and walkways with style and comfort. If you’d like to keep your view unobstructed while enjoying wind and rain protection, our clear PVC blinds are the perfect choice. We also offer electric canopy awnings that can be operated with the touch of a button for greater convenience.

We’re dedicated to providing the means for homeowners and businesses to protect themselves from the harsh Australian sun and other unpleasant weather conditions. That’s why our custom-made all-weather extendable shade and retractable roof systems, awnings and blinds are found throughout Victoria in restaurants, cafes, hotels, universities, schools, child care centres, retirement homes and many private residences.

Our specialists are committed to helping you find the right external blinds and awnings for your home or workplace, whether you require a balcony awning or an extendable shade solution such as a retractable awning. We’ll consult closely with you and offer our expert advice so that you have the right retractable outdoor blinds or awnings for your needs. Through the guidance of our friendly team, you can have customised shades that are durable, easy to operate and stylish – all at very competitive prices.

Get in touch with our office on (03) 9595 9000 or send us an email today – we’d love to hear from you and discuss the best possible way to provide shade and beauty to your Melbourne property with the help of our outdoor awning blinds.

secondary_content.text: Are you searching for a house awning or shade system to enhance your home? As specialists in producing quality blinds and awnings, Melbourne Awnings and Shade Systems can supply, create and install a wide range of shade awnings and other solutions for customers wanting to transform their homes and businesses.

With over 35 years’ experience providing shade systems and custom awnings to Melbourne residents, we are dedicated to offering products that suit your lifestyle and meet your outdoor shade requirements.

Our products are designed to withstand the Australian climate, so you can rest assured that our blinds and external awnings offer Melbourne customers all season protection. Canvas designs are ideal for door covers, sun blinds, balcony shades and veranda shades. If you’re looking for cost-effective all weather awnings, we have an extensive selection of canvas blinds and awnings to choose from.

Available in a range of colours and patterns, our canvas products can improve your outdoor area. If you want a professional look for your business or home in Melbourne, canvas blinds and awnings provide vital shade and a welcoming atmosphere for your home.

Residents will find outdoor patio awnings and blinds are an innovative way to update a home or business. We offer standard Colorbond head-box hooding and various fabric types to guarantee top-of-the-line outdoor awnings. Customers will benefit from convenient features such as manual pulleys and motorised functions.

At Melbourne Awnings and Shade Systems, we pride ourselves on providing affordable, weather-proof products to cater to the needs of residents in Melbourne. Our external awnings and blinds allow you to enjoy the comfort of your home while saving on cooling costs.

Our external blinds and awnings are the perfect addition to any home or business in Melbourne. Our outdoor retractable blinds are ideal for upstairs windows and have several benefits, including cost reduction and security. External blinds are also available with timer functions and climate sensors.

Through our superior installation services and high-quality solutions for blinds and patio awnings, Melbourne customers can turn their patio dreams into reality. Ready to update your home or business? Get in touch with our office on (03) 9595 9000 or send us an email today to learn more and request a quote – we’d love to help you renovate your outdoor area.
